notes.note: Reviewed against the delta: wording corrections only, from the final review: the failed-lifecycle claim is qualified to a fresh start; the contracts page now states that a resend landing before the exit is projected sees the session open (self-healing on the next send), that a Stop during session/new ends the events as stopped while the caller still gets the typed refusal, and that a lazy-start refusal ends with the row closed; plus a comment on which resend rows depend on the session having ended. Changed sources: docs/guides/acp.md. The change is wording inside contracts.md/acp.md about the ACP refused-start session end; searched this document for claims about the refused session's lifecycle, resend and exit ordering: none that the correction contradicts. No prose change needed.
